feeds.title: Ecobnb Blog
feeds.description: Discover incredible itineraries by foot, horseback or bicycle, and sustainable ideas to visit Italy, responsible travel and live in harmony with Nature. Ecobnb is the community of sustainable accommodations. A network that thrives on tourism that respects nature and local communities.

feeds.title: Drink Tea and Travel
feeds.description: A Canadian couple inspired by the world, fueled by curiosity, a sense of adventure, and a desire to make a positive impact on the destinations and communities we visit. Drink Tea & Travel is an award-winning sustainable travel blog with a mission to inspire an alternative lifestyle and sustainable travel practices around the world.

feeds.title: Travel to Blank
feeds.description: We are Steven and Jazmin. In our guides we share hidden gems to promote sustainability, and include off the beaten path stops that highlight diverse backgrounds and experiences while promoting diversity and inclusion, no matter how you travel.

feeds.title: Suitcase Six
feeds.description: Suitcase Six is a resource for working women who want to travel and live more sustainably. Let's add a little 'eco' to our adventure.

feeds.title: Charlie on Travel Blog
feeds.description: Travel guides from around the world and responsible travel advice from the UK travel bloggers. We're Charlie and Luke. We travel slow and write about sustainable travel.

feeds.title: Breathe Dream Go
feeds.description: Inspiration for life-changing travel adventures in India and beyondBreathedreamgo is published by Canadian travel writer Mariellen Ward. It was launched in 2009 and focuses on transformative travel, travel in India, travel in Canada, responsible travel, and solo female travel.

feeds.title: Sustainable Travel International Blog
feeds.description: Stories of the people, places & partners that make travel and tourism tick. We believe that travel and tourism can protect the world's natural and cultural riches and create economic opportunity.

feeds.title: Every Steph
feeds.description: Blog posts on Travel guides, travel destinations, healthy recipes and lifestyle. Stefania, a full-time traveler originally from Italy wants to show you how sustainable travel can easily go hand in hand with a touch of luxury.

feeds.title: Ethical Traveler
feeds.description: Ethical Traveler is a nonprofit organization seeking to use the economic clout of tourism to protect human rights and the environment.

feeds.title: Barriers & Borders
feeds.description: We are Forum and Shiva and we run the travel blog - barriersandborders.com with a focus on conscious and sustainable travel experiences around the world. Barriers and Borders is born out of our constant inquisitiveness and endless desire to experience, live, and learn from every remote corner of our marvelous planet. BnB is not only limited to our curiosity and love for travel but also intends to break the obstacles and demarcations that we as a society have built around ourselves over generations.

feeds.title: EcoHotels Travel Blog
feeds.description: Explore the world of sustainability, Sustainable Living, and Green Hotels. The EcoHotels Travel blog shares some exciting options and destinations for ecologically conscious tourists. EcoHotels Travel is one of the most sustainable booking sites and only represents hotels that are committed to sustainability and have trustworthy certifications to prove it.

feeds.title: Paulina on the Road
feeds.description: Find the best articles on the travel blog about sustainable travel and outdoor travel. Discover fun outdoor activities like hiking, cycling, sailing with adventure seeker Paulina.

feeds.title: Travel For Wildlife Blog
feeds.description: Follow along as we share photography, videos, and articles from our adventures! Travel For Wildlife focuses on ethical wildlife tourism and we want everyone to enjoy wildlife without harming them or their habitat in any way. Our mission is to promote wildlife conservation through responsible wildlife tourism.

feeds.title: Everything Zany » Sustainable Tourism
feeds.description: Sharing various topics that could help to achieve sustainable tourism by being a responsible eco-traveller that respects and protect nature, culture, and our planet.

feeds.title: Verdemode
feeds.description: I'm Linda and welcome to Verdemode, a green lifestyle, travel, and design blog. It's a place where I get to share my passion for the environment and all things sustainable, and hope you'll find something on here that will help shape the way you live.

feeds.title: Green Global Travel Blog
feeds.description: World's largest independent Ecotourism & Green Living Blog aims to inspire people to travel & live more sustainably, & encourage others to make a positive impact. Green Global Travel is an ecotourism, nature/wildlife conservation & cultural preservation website focused on encouraging people to travel more adventurously, consciously, and sustainably.

feeds.title: The Shooting Star Blog
feeds.description: Exclusive stories at the intersection of meaningful travel, sustainable living, and self discovery. The Shooting Star is a solo, offbeat and responsible travel blog run by Shivya Nath, voted among the best travel bloggers in India.

feeds.title: Softback Travel
feeds.description: Blog posts on sustainability, camping, environment, wildlife, and more. Softback Travel offers stories and explains things to inform and encourage you to go on your own adventure, travel sustainably, and enjoy our planet's wonderful and valuable wildlife.
